anomalies.observed: The RJ45 J7 transmit pair TD+/TD- is wired to NET0046/NET0013, which are the SKW92A U7 LAN_PORT3_TX-/LAN_PORT3_TX+ pins, while the receive pair RD+/RD- is wired to NET0009/NET0002, which are U7 LAN_PORT2_RX-/LAN_PORT2_RX+ pins. One center-tap pin on J7 is tied to NET0057, which is also connected to U7 LAN_PORT2_TX+.
anomalies.expected: Both the TD and RD pairs of the RJ45 must connect to the TX and RX pairs of the same Ethernet PHY port, and transformer center taps must go to the appropriate termination/common-mode node, not to a PHY data line.

evidence.quote: EthernetAndPower sheet: J7 TD+→NET0046, TD−→NET0013, RD+→NET0009, RD−→NET0002, CT→NET0057; SkylabModule sheet: U7 LAN_PORT3_TX−/TX+ = NET0046/NET0013, LAN_PORT2_RX+/− = NET0002/NET0009, LAN_PORT2_TX+ = NET0057.
J5 | RJ45 Amphenol RJMG1BD3B8K1ANR | Ethernet jack

anomalies.impact: The Ethernet jack is not connected as a usable single port: TX comes from one switch port and RX from another, and a center tap is shorted to a data line. Ethernet communication will be unreliable or nonfunctional, with possible bias/EMI problems.

anomalies.observed: C1 is drawn as 10 uF/6.3 V between the EPD display-power net NET0024 and GND.
anomalies.expected: The G1-group EPD reference uses a 1 uF/6.3 V capacitor for this position.

evidence.quote: C1 (G1 group only): 1 µF/6.3 V | C2 = 1 µF/6.3 V | Matches G1-specific value

anomalies.impact: The EPD boost input capacitance is 10x the intended value. This can alter EPD power-up, startup current, leakage and panel waveform behavior.

parsed.summary: The schematic contains real deviations: the RJ45 jack is wired across different SKW92A LAN ports and a center tap is tied to a PHY data net, and the EPD input capacitor C1 is 10 uF/6.3 V instead of the specified 1 uF/6.3 V.
